summary: حفاظت مسیر واقعی مقصد، جداسازی source/staging/backup، جلوگیری از عبور reparse point و خروج فایل تنظیمات از ریشه؛ staging یکتا و حفظ پوشه‌های بدون مالکیت اثبات‌شده.
limitations: Automatic backup/release retention is deferred: retained content needs disk-capacity management.
The remote service remains gated; remote recovery is not implemented.
CLI independent backup/rollback helpers and all ancillary filesystem utilities are not fully remediated.
External filesystem mutation and path aliases require runtime/environment verification.
